sloka: ततः प्रहस्य तद्रक्षः शूलं जग्राह पाणिना ।वधाय सानुबन्धस्य मुमोचायुधमुत्तमम् ।। ७.६७.२० ॥
transliteration: tataḥ prahasya tadrakṣaḥ śūlaṁ jagrāha pāṇinā ।vadhāya sānubandhasya mumocāyudhamuttamam ।। 7.67.20 ॥

translations.english: Then, that demon Lavaṇa laughed loudly, took the excellent trident in his hand, and released that supreme weapon to kill the king along with his retinue.
